WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.199232 25.801806)', 4326)::geometry AS g
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT r.road_name,
         r.geometry::geometry AS geom,
         ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.199232 25.801806)', 4326)::geography) AS dist_m
  FROM roads r, ref
  WHERE r.highway = 'residential'
    AND r.road_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Dimension(r.geometry::geometry) = 1
    AND ST_NPoints(r.geometry::geometry) BETWEEN 2 AND 50
    AND r.geometry::geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-126, 24, -66, 50, 4326)
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.199232 25.801806)', 4326)::geography, 100000)
  ORDER BY r.geometry::geometry <-> ref.g
  LIMIT 1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(n.geom)).geom AS seg FROM nearest n
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
         ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
         ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT e.seg_len_m,
         z1.v AS z1,
         z2.v AS z2
  FROM endpoints e
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p1) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p1)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z1 ON z1.v IS NOT NULL
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p2) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z2 ON z2.v IS NOT NULL
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT seg_len_m,
         CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.road_name,
       n.dist_m,
       DEGREES(ATAN(SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0))) AS slope_deg
FROM nearest n
CROSS JOIN slopes
WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.road_name, n.dist_m;

```sql
WITH gallery_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-80.199232, 25.801806), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
residential_road AS (
  SELECT 
    r.id,
    r.geometry
  FROM 
    roads r
  WHERE 
    r.highway = 'residential'
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geometry, (SELECT geom::geometry FROM gallery_geom), 1000)
  ORDER BY 
    r.geometry <-> (SELECT geom::geometry FROM gallery_geom)
  LIMIT 1
),
nearest_road_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    geometry
  FROM 
    residential_road
),
distance_to_road AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Distance(
      (SELECT geom FROM gallery_geom),
      (SELECT geometry::geography FROM nearest_road_geom)
    ) AS distance_meters
),
slope_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Avg(
      ST_Slope(
        ST_Clip(
          r.rast,
          (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM nearest_road_geom),
          TRUE
        ),
        1
      )
    ) AS avg_slope_degrees
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(
      r.rast,
      (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM nearest_road_geom)
    )
)
SELECT 
  'Gallery 2612, Miami, FL' AS feature_name,
  (SELECT distance_meters FROM distance_to_road) AS distance_to_road_meters,
  (SELECT avg_slope_degrees FROM slope_analysis) AS avg_slope_degrees;
```
